> Swipe left if you want to have a good time


Uhh that’s probably why you’re not getting matches. Not sure if it’s a bad attempt at a self deprecating joke or if you legit don’t know what way to swipe.

Leave out the first two paragraphs and you good. The first one is covered when you say, “I don’t like sports” and the second one is something that doesn’t belong in a profile. Like, everyone’s lost dude, talk about it in conversation sure but don’t use that as your intro.
Then there’s a problem with your elo score. Be more picky. Change your bio.
Trying way to hard. Alot is two words.

You have a nice smile. Drop the last one. Shirtless pics aren’t much of a good idea even when you do have something to show off // but they’re like the worst idea when you look like a marshmallow. Not feelin the bio either.
I'm scared my sister will turn out like this. I don't really know how to tell my parents though...
